title: Coaching Hannah on the New Hires
analyzerModelNote: Opus same as MC1 — do not change

sourceLessons.title: How to Identify Strengths and Gaps in the Team
How to Give Real-Time Feedback That Works

checklistItems.label: Hannah plans to book a two-day course for the new hires. Decide with her what to do.
Two of the six new hires have left, and two more look unhappy. Agree with Hannah what, if anything, should change for new hires.
All four new hires on Joel’s team are still there. Decide with Hannah what to do about that.

scenarioSummary.now: You manage the client teams at a small marketing agency. Hannah leads the account team. Six new people joined her team this year. Two have already left, and two more look unhappy. Hannah plans to book a two-day course for the new hires, and the invoice would come to you. She asked to talk to you before she does.
scenarioSummary.layers: A the course: book it vs ask what really happens in a new hire's first week → B welcoming new hires: more in the handbook vs one real task and a day-one check-in, and why → C Joel's team: copy a checklist vs bring Joel's way to the team leads (group, demo or pairing) with a clear start.
